scope: Corollary 5.9 (Separated original parents) of the manuscript “The Boltzmann–Grad limit for stable radial potentials on regular kinetic intervals” (preprints/The-Boltzmann-Grad-limit-for-stable-radial-potentials-on-regular-kinetic-intervals-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce9fe5976f17b89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Given L, A, δ > 0 and M0 < ∞, one can discard finite terms of total integral at most ηΓe−M0p so that, except at fewer than δp ordinary pins, the original parent is at distance greater than ε.85 from every other already displayed path immediately before the insertion. This assertion is used for large histories; fixed bounded orders are treated by their direct geometric estimates.
